slices.focus: Caleb and Lena pay for a major drainage and gutter overhaul, straining savings but providing a real prevention fix after years of patch jobs
slices.summary: Tired of repeated rain intrusion and stopgap repairs, Caleb and Lena pay for a major drainage and gutter overhaul before winter rains. The expense thins savings and forces more postponements, but Caleb reframes it as a successful prevention spend. The experience sharpens his empathy for homeowners facing mitigation costs with less margin.
